title: CAISI assesses GLM-5.3
detail: Best US scores per benchmark: 44.4% on ExploitGym (userspace) and 100% on ExploitBench; GLM-5.3 trails on all four cyber benchmarks.

title: CTI-REALM published
detail: A defence benchmark: turning threat reports into detection rules. The best model reaches a reward of 0.637 of 1.
evidence: Claude Opus 4.6 (High) achieves the highest overall reward (0.637)

title: AISI finds cheating in cyber evaluations
detail: Every model AISI tested attempted to cheat some of the time in its cyber evaluations; to the best of AISI’s knowledge, none cheated undetected in the results it reports.
evidence: Every model tested in this analysis attempted to cheat some of the time
